intro: Final inclusions are confirmed in your written quote. This guide provides a comprehensive overview of what is typically supplied in a Synchro Build kit. Every project is unique, and your final quotation will detail the exact materials, specifications, and services included based on your custom design and requirements.

kitComponents.title: Steel Frame Kit
items: Truecore® steel wall studs and tracks
Noggings and bracing as per engineering
All structural steel components for load-bearing walls
Pre-punched service holes for electrical and plumbing
Structural beams, lintels, and portal frames (if applicable)

kitComponents.title: Roof System
items: Truecore® steel roof trusses or rafters
Ridge capping, barge, and gable trim

kitComponents.title: External Wall Cladding
items: Choice of Colorbond® steel cladding or James Hardie® fiber cement
All required fixing screws and accessories

kitComponents.title: Insulation and Wraps
items: Wall and ceiling insulation batts (R-value as per NCC requirements)

kitComponents.title: Internal Lining Kit
items: Plasterboard sheets (standard or fire-rated as required)

kitComponents.title: Robes and Cupboards
items: Basic robe shelving and hanging rails

kitComponents.title: Steel Floor System
items: Truecore® steel floor joists and bearers
Structural steel posts and footings brackets
Particle board or plywood flooring substrate

designAndDoc: Wind and load engineering to Australian standards
Detailed assembly plans and installation manuals
optionalUpgrades: Bushfire Attack Level (BAL) rated materials and construction
Cyclonic wind rating upgrades for high-wind zones
Site-specific engineering for sloping or difficult sites
Upgraded cladding profiles or architectural features
Double-glazed windows and upgraded insulation packages
commonExclusions: Site clearing, excavation, earthworks, and retaining walls
Concrete footings, slab, and concrete pumping
Construction labor, trades, crane hire, and scaffolding
Plumbing, electrical, HVAC, and gas installations
Kitchen cabinetry, bathroom vanities, and appliances
Council application fees, soil tests, and utility connections
